description: Human-verified ground truth for the customer support email classifier. Labels are the author's judgment; review every notes field before trusting a label.

cases.input: Hi, I was charged twice for my subscription this month. Please refund the duplicate payment.
cases.notes: Explicit duplicate-charge signal. The canonical billing case.

cases.input: I cannot log in to my account. The password reset link is not arriving in my inbox.
cases.notes: Access-recovery case. Reset link missing is still an account issue, not technical, because no error is reported.

cases.input: The API keeps returning HTTP 500 status code when uploading CSV files.
cases.notes: Concrete server error code. Textbook technical.

cases.input: What are your business operating hours and support SLA response times?
cases.notes: Pure information request, no account or system state involved.

cases.input: Can I upgrade my subscription plan from monthly to annual billing?
cases.notes: Plan change with explicit billing wording. Labeled billing over account because money and renewal terms change.

cases.input: Could you send me a copy of last month's invoice? I need it for my accountant.
cases.notes: Invoice document request.

cases.input: I need to update the credit card on file before my next renewal.
cases.notes: Payment-method change. Tempting to call it account, but no login or profile state is involved.

cases.input: I applied promo code SAVE20 at checkout but the discount was not applied to my total.
cases.notes: Pricing and discount dispute.

cases.input: I requested a refund 10 days ago and I still do not see it on my statement.
cases.notes: Refund status follow-up.

cases.input: Please cancel my subscription and refund this month's charge.
cases.notes: Cancellation plus refund. Refund makes billing the stronger label over account.

cases.input: After I downgraded, I was charged a prorated amount I do not understand. Can you explain the math?
cases.notes: Requires billing-cycle and proration knowledge to answer.

cases.input: We need a VAT invoice with our company tax ID included for compliance.
cases.notes: Tax documentation. The word compliance tempts a general label, but the deliverable is a billing document.

cases.input: Can we move our billing date to the 1st of each month to match our accounting cycle?
cases.notes: Billing cycle configuration change.

cases.input: My card was declined but I still see a charge pending. What happened?
cases.notes: Payment failure combined with a pending charge; concerns payment state.

cases.input: The invoice shows 25 seats but we only have 18 active users this month.
cases.notes: Quantity dispute. Could read as account administration, but the artifact under dispute is the invoice.

cases.input: Can we switch our invoices from USD to EUR? Our finance team is based in Berlin.
cases.notes: Currency and invoicing configuration.

cases.input: I received an overdue balance notice but our account has always been current. Please review.
cases.notes: Disputes a billing notice. Uses the word account, so it is a deliberate distractor.

cases.input: Our annual renewal is coming up and I noticed the price increased. Can you explain?
cases.notes: Renewal pricing question.

cases.input: I never signed up for a paid plan. My free trial just ended and now I have been charged.
cases.notes: Genuinely ambiguous billing vs account. Labeled billing because the actionable complaint is an unwanted charge; the trial state is context.

cases.input: We are a registered nonprofit. How do we apply for tax-exempt billing status?
cases.notes: Reads like onboarding but the outcome is a change to billing status. Good test of intent vs tone.

cases.input: The receipt I received shows a different amount than the confirmation email. Which one is correct?
cases.notes: Contradictory billing artifacts; needs reconciliation.

cases.input: Can I add a purchase order number to future invoices for our procurement team?
cases.notes: Invoice metadata configuration request.

cases.input: Our finance department needs invoices consolidated into one monthly document instead of per-seat charges.
cases.notes: Ambiguous billing vs account. Consolidated invoicing is a billing preference tied to the org structure; labeled billing because the output is a financial document.

cases.input: The app crashes every time I try to upload a file larger than 10MB.
cases.notes: Reproducible crash with a clear threshold.

cases.input: Our nightly webhook deliveries stopped two days ago. No errors on our end.
cases.notes: Integration failure. Mentions no error, so the classifier must infer from the broken pipeline.

cases.input: Exports to PDF come out blank after the latest release.
cases.notes: Feature breakage tied to a release.

cases.input: The mobile app on iOS closes immediately when I open the reports tab.
cases.notes: Platform-specific crash.

cases.input: Search returns zero results even for records I can see in the list view.
cases.notes: Inconsistent behavior between two code paths; no error code given.

cases.input: We are getting 429 rate limit errors during our bulk sync.
cases.notes: API throttling. 429 is an error code so it is a clear technical tell.

cases.input: Data I enter on the web app does not appear on mobile for about an hour.
cases.notes: Replication delay. Latency implies a pipeline problem.

cases.input: I get 'Error 1042' when saving a new customer record. What does it mean?
cases.notes: Error code blocks a write operation. The question mark tempts general, but the trigger is a system fault.

cases.input: Your dashboard does not render correctly in Safari 16. Charts overlap.
cases.notes: Browser-specific rendering defect.

cases.input: Our SAML SSO login started failing with a signature validation error after we rotated certificates.
cases.notes: Ambiguous technical vs account. SSO is identity territory, but a signature validation error is a protocol-level fault. Labeled technical.

cases.input: Our API token stopped working and returns 401 despite not expiring.
cases.notes: Machine-to-machine auth failure. Distinct from a human login problem, which would be account.

cases.input: We see database connection timeouts during peak hours.
cases.notes: Infrastructure symptom during load.

cases.input: Attachments over 25MB are rejected with a size limit error. Can the limit be raised?
cases.notes: Requests a configuration change, but the trigger is a system-enforced limit.

cases.input: Email and push notifications stopped being delivered to our users last week.
cases.notes: Delivery pipeline failure across two channels.

cases.input: Dark mode makes some table text invisible.
cases.notes: Styling and rendering bug.

cases.input: A CSV import partially succeeded: 40 rows loaded, 60 silently skipped.
cases.notes: Silent failure with data-integrity impact. High-severity technical.

cases.input: The login page returns a 502 Bad Gateway intermittently.
cases.notes: Ambiguous technical vs account; the word login pulls toward account, but 502 is an infrastructure fault, not a credential problem.

cases.input: Scheduled report emails send twice every morning.
cases.notes: Duplicate execution in a scheduler.

cases.input: The integration with our Slack workspace disconnects every few days and needs reauthorizing.
cases.notes: Recurring integration failure. Reauthorizing sounds account-ish, which is the distractor.

cases.input: I need to change the email address associated with my account.
cases.notes: Identity change on the user record.

cases.input: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
cases.notes: Security setting on the user's own account.

cases.input: Please permanently delete my account and all associated data.
cases.notes: Account lifecycle request.

cases.input: We accidentally created two accounts. Can they be merged?
cases.notes: Account consolidation.

cases.input: I need to transfer ownership of our workspace to a colleague.
cases.notes: Ownership and role change.

cases.input: My account is locked after too many failed login attempts.
cases.notes: Lockout is a policy state on the account, not a system fault.

cases.input: I want to update the display name and job title on my profile.
cases.notes: Profile metadata edit.

cases.input: How do I invite three new team members to our workspace?
cases.notes: User provisioning.

cases.input: Please remove a former employee's access immediately.
cases.notes: Offboarding. Security-sensitive and often urgent.

cases.input: I forgot my password and want to set a new one.
cases.notes: Credential reset.

cases.input: I no longer have access to the email on my old account. How can I recover it?
cases.notes: Recovery when the recovery factor itself is lost. Harder identity verification.

cases.input: Can you change my role from Viewer to Admin?
cases.notes: Permission change, permission-sensitive.

cases.input: I want to change the timezone on my account so reports align with my local time.
cases.notes: User preference stored on the account.

cases.input: Signing in with Google created a second profile instead of linking to my existing one.
cases.notes: Identity linking problem. Could be read as a technical bug, but the resolution is account merging.

cases.input: We need to verify our company domain to control who can sign up.
cases.notes: Domain and tenant administration.

cases.input: My session logs me out every five minutes, which is impractical.
cases.notes: Ambiguous account vs technical: could be a deliberate session policy or a bug. Labeled account because session lifetime is typically a configured policy; note the uncertainty.

cases.input: Can I close my account now and reopen it later without losing my data?
cases.notes: Asks about lifecycle policy and data retention.

cases.input: Our account was suspended without explanation. Please reinstate it.
cases.notes: Ambiguous account vs billing: suspensions frequently originate in failed payments, but no billing detail is given. Labeled account on the text alone.

cases.input: I would like a copy of all personal data you hold about me.
cases.notes: Ambiguous account vs general: a data subject request framed as compliance, but the subject is the user's own account data.

cases.input: Do you offer a discount for annual prepayment?
cases.notes: Pre-sales question. No existing charge, which keeps it out of billing.

cases.input: Do you have a public REST API, and where is the documentation?
cases.notes: Asks whether a capability exists rather than reporting a failure. That distinction separates it from technical.

cases.input: Is there a partner or reseller program we could join?
cases.notes: Business development inquiry.

cases.input: Is a bulk import or CRM integration on the roadmap?
cases.notes: Product roadmap question.

cases.input: Where can I find the getting-started guide?
cases.notes: Documentation pointer.

cases.input: Do you run training webinars for new customers?
cases.notes: Enablement question.

cases.input: Are you SOC 2 Type II certified? We need it for our vendor review.
cases.notes: Compliance inquiry for procurement. Tone is formal, which can mislead.

cases.input: Can you confirm where our data is stored and whether it stays in the EU?
cases.notes: Ambiguous general vs technical: data residency is a contractual and compliance question, not a live failure. Labeled general.

cases.input: What is the difference between the Pro and Enterprise plans?
cases.notes: Plan comparison before purchase.

cases.input: I would like to speak with someone in sales about a 200-seat rollout.
cases.notes: Sales handoff request.

cases.input: Just a suggestion: it would help if the export menu remembered my last format.
cases.notes: Product feedback, not a defect report.

cases.input: Are you hiring backend engineers? I could not find a careers page.
cases.notes: Recruiting inquiry. Mentions a missing page, which is a distractor toward technical.

cases.input: I am writing an article about your company and would like a comment.
cases.notes: Press inquiry.

cases.input: Is there a public status page I can check during outages?
cases.notes: Ambiguous general vs technical: outage-adjacent, but the request is for an information resource, not a fix.

cases.input: Do you support HIPAA and will you sign a BAA?
cases.notes: Compliance and contract question.

cases.input: Is support available in Spanish, and during which hours?
cases.notes: Service availability inquiry written in English about another language.

cases.input: Hola, quisiera saber cuánto cuesta el plan para 50 usuarios y si incluye soporte prioritario.
cases.notes: Mixed-language edge case (Spanish). Asks pricing and support availability, which is a pre-sales question rather than a billing dispute. Tests multilingual handling.

cases.input: Great job on the update. Now the app takes a full minute to load a page. Absolutely brilliant work.
cases.notes: Sarcasm edge case. Literal sentiment is positive while intent is a performance complaint. Labeled technical because the actionable content is a latency defect.

cases.input: cant log in!! reset lnik never arives. plz help asap!!!
cases.notes: Typo-laden and terse edge case. Same intent as case_2 with degraded surface form: tests robustness to misspellings and excessive punctuation.
